Hi Jordan —

Following up from our internal review: you're correct, the reserved capacity line was double-counted due to a reconciliation script that re-ingested a migration batch on 2026-02-28. The duplicated line was applied to a small subset of accounts (including Acme).

What we propose:
1) Issue a formal credit memo (corrected invoice) for INV-202602 to reflect a $18,432 credit before VAT; the credit memo will indicate the original invoice number and reason: "duplicate charge due to ingestion error."
2) Apply a goodwill credit of $5,000 (pre-VAT) to demonstrate our regret for the operational impact. This will appear as a separate credit memo but can be combined if you prefer one document.
3) Recalculate VAT and provide a VAT breakdown and certificate suitable for your AP/tax team.

Options for receiving funds:
- If you prefer a refund to the original payment method, we can initiate an ACH refund (ETA 7–10 business days after approval).
- If you'd rather a credit on your next invoice, we can apply the net credit (duplicate charge + goodwill) to your April statement; that will speed reconciliation on your side.

Attached is a short usage extract showing the duplicated entries (usage_report_Q4.csv). I've also included a summary CSV for your finance team.

Please let us know which path you prefer and whether the goodwill credit should be itemized separately for audit. Once you confirm, we'll issue the credit memo(s) and send VAT documentation.

Apologies again for the disruption — we'll also be opening an internal postmortem.

Regards,
Monica Patel
